newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Casinos opens new casino in Canada.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Casinos opens new casino in Canada.

text.p: Australian-listed casino operator Casinos Austria International Ltd said on Monday it had opened its first land-based casino in North America on January 31.
The company said the Great Blue Heron Casino, located on Scugog Island just outside of Toronto, officially began operations after a 12-month development programme.

"Occupying a 5,000 square metre complex, the casino comprises 40 gaming tables, a high stakes bingo hall for up to 640 players, a range of food and beverage outlets and extensive car-parking facilities," the company said in a statement.
Casinos Austria has a 72 percent stake in a contract to operate the casino which it secured from the Mississaugas of the indigenous Scugog First National people early last year.
"The company is forecasting that the Great Blue Heron Casino will initially contribute between A$1.3 million to A$1.5 million in annual revenue to the company," Casinos Austria said.
Casinos Austria operates three Australian casinos in Canberra, Cairns and Christmas Island, as well as two casinos in Egypt, and one each in Argentina and Costa Rica.

The company is pursuing a casino licence in Wellington, New Zealand, and is part of an international consortium pursuing a number of licences in South Africa. Casinos Austria is controlled by Vienna-based Casinos Austria Ag.
Casinos Austria shares last traded at 20 cents on January 31.
